news.titleEn: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
news.conclusionEn: The US added only 29,000 jobs in September, far below the 84,000 expected, and unemployment rose to 4.2%.
news.conclusionZh: 美国9月仅新增2.9万个就业，远逊预期，失业率升至4.2%
news.whyEn: A clearly cooling labor market changes the Fed's calculus just weeks before its October meeting.
news.whyZh: 就业明显降温，直接改变美联储10月会议前的加息判断
news.detailEn: Economists had expected about 84,000 new jobs and a 4.1% unemployment rate. Revisions cut 60,000 jobs from prior months, with July now showing a loss of 10,000. Annual wage growth slipped to its lowest since May 2021, easing worries about wage-driven inflation. Markets read the weak data as reducing pressure for another rate hike.
news.detailZh: 经济学家原预期新增约8.4万个就业、失业率4.1%。前两个月数据合计下修6万，7月改为减少1万。工资年增速降至2021年5月以来最低，缓解了工资推升通胀的担忧。市场将疲软数据解读为再加息压力下降。

news.titleEn: Traders now see little chance of a Fed rate hike in October after weak jobs report
news.conclusionEn: Futures-implied odds of an October Fed hike fell to about 17%, down from roughly 36% a week earlier.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储10月加息概率从约36%骤降至17%左右
news.whyEn: Rate expectations drive bond yields, mortgage costs, the dollar and equity valuations worldwide.
news.whyZh: 利率预期牵动全球债市、房贷成本、美元和股市估值
news.detailEn: CME FedWatch put the probability of a quarter-point hike on Oct. 28 at about 17%, while Kalshi showed 18%, down from nearly 70% a week ago. A cooler-than-expected PCE inflation reading earlier in the week had already started shifting bets. Investors still price a possible hike in December, and the 10-year Treasury yield remains elevated above 5%.
news.detailZh: CME FedWatch显示10月28日加息25个基点的概率约17%，预测市场Kalshi为18%，一周前接近70%。本周早些时候PCE通胀低于预期，已开始改变押注。投资者仍预期12月可能加息，10年期美债收益率仍高于5%。

news.titleEn: G7 countries agree on release of diesel and oil stocks after US pressure
news.conclusionEn: G7 nations agreed to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude from emergency reserves over four months.
news.conclusionZh: G7同意四个月内释放1亿桶柴油和原油战略储备
news.whyEn: It eases a global fuel squeeze caused by the Iran war and averts a threatened US ban on diesel exports.
news.whyZh: 缓解伊朗战争引发的燃油紧缺，并避免美国禁止柴油出口
news.detailEn: The coordinated IEA release includes a front-loaded diesel component within the first 20 days, and members pledged not to restrict energy exports among themselves. Washington had warned it could ban diesel exports if Europe did not act. US diesel futures fell over 3% and European diesel futures about 5.75% on the news. The move follows a 400-million-barrel IEA release in March.
news.detailZh: 此次通过国际能源署协调的释放计划，前20天将集中投放柴油，成员国还承诺彼此间不限制能源出口。美国此前警告若欧洲不行动将禁止柴油出口。消息公布后美国柴油期货跌超3%，欧洲柴油期货跌约5.75%。此前IEA已在3月释放4亿桶。

news.titleEn: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Oct. 2
news.conclusionEn: Brent hovered near $102 as a tanker was hit in the Strait of Hormuz and US forces built up in the Gulf.
news.conclusionZh: 霍尔木兹海峡油轮遇袭，布伦特原油徘徊在102美元附近
news.whyEn: Any disruption in Hormuz threatens a key share of global oil and gas flows and keeps inflation risks high.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹受阻威胁全球油气供应，通胀风险居高不下
news.detailEn: UKMTO said a tanker leaving the strait was struck by an unknown projectile, causing a small fire and a blackout but no casualties. The Pentagon is sending about 9,000 more troops and a third aircraft carrier to the region, while Iranian lawmakers advanced a bill asserting control over Hormuz traffic. WTI settled around $91 on Friday and Brent near $102, with Brent heading for a weekly decline after the G7 stock-release deal.
news.detailZh: 英国海事贸易行动办公室称，一艘驶出海峡的油轮被不明飞行物击中，引发小火和断电，无人员伤亡。五角大楼正向该地区增派约9000名士兵和第三艘航母，伊朗议会同时推进宣示管控霍尔木兹通行的法案。周五WTI收于约91美元，布伦特约102美元，因G7释储协议本周料录得下跌。

news.titleEn: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq rally as Fed rate-hike expectations fade, tech gains
news.conclusionEn: US stocks rose Friday on the weak jobs data, with the Nasdaq up 1.19% to 27,190.86 led by tech.
news.conclusionZh: 疲软就业数据提振美股，纳指涨1.19%领涨
news.whyEn: "Bad news is good news": investors are betting slower growth will stop the Fed from tightening further.
news.whyZh: 「坏消息即好消息」：市场押注经济放缓让美联储停止加息
news.detailEn: The Dow added roughly 250 points to about 51,176, and Nvidia helped push the Nasdaq to an intraday record. Despite Friday's gains, the Dow and S&P 500 posted weekly losses, while the Nasdaq ended the week higher. Elevated Treasury yields remain the main headwind for valuations.
news.detailZh: 道指上涨约250点至51176点附近，英伟达带动纳指盘中创新高。尽管周五上涨，道指和标普500本周仍录得下跌，纳指则周线收涨。高企的美债收益率仍是估值的主要压力。

news.titleEn: Tokyo inflation hits 2.7% in September as some subsidies come to an end
news.conclusionEn: Tokyo core CPI jumped to 2.7% in September, the fastest in 10 months, beating the 2.4% forecast.
news.conclusionZh: 东京9月核心CPI升至2.7%，创10个月新高
news.whyEn: It strengthens the case for further Bank of Japan rate hikes, affecting the yen and global carry trades.
news.whyZh: 强化日本央行继续加息预期，影响日元和全球套息交易
news.detailEn: Core inflation accelerated from 1.8% in August as some energy subsidies expired, and a measure excluding fresh food and fuel rose 3.0%. The BOJ will issue fresh quarterly forecasts at its Oct. 29-30 meeting. Markets price about an 82% chance of a hike by December. The Nikkei fell about 1% on Friday and Hong Kong's Hang Seng dropped 2.6% after its holiday break.
news.detailZh: 部分能源补贴到期，核心通胀从8月的1.8%加速上升，剔除生鲜食品和能源的指标升至3.0%。日本央行将在10月29-30日会议上发布新的季度预测。市场预计12月前加息概率约82%。周五日经指数跌约1%，港股恒指节后复市跌2.6%。

news.titleEn: Novartis Inks Chinese mRNA-Therapy Deal for Up to $7.8 Billion
news.conclusionEn: Novartis licensed an mRNA-based autoimmune therapy from China's Abogen in a deal worth up to $7.8 billion.
news.conclusionZh: 诺华以最高78亿美元引进中国艾博生物mRNA自免疗法
news.whyEn: It underlines how Western drugmakers are increasingly sourcing innovation from Chinese biotech.
news.whyZh: 凸显西方药企越来越多地从中国生物科技公司获取创新
news.detailEn: Novartis will pay $575 million upfront for rights to an mRNA-encoded T-cell engager targeting autoimmune disease. The rest of the value depends on development and commercial milestones. China-originated assets have become a major share of global pharma licensing deals, despite US political scrutiny of biotech ties with China.
news.detailZh: 诺华将预付5.75亿美元，获得一款用于自身免疫疾病的mRNA编码T细胞衔接器的权益，其余金额取决于研发和商业里程碑。尽管美国对中美生物科技合作有政治审查，源自中国的资产已占全球药企授权交易的相当份额。

news.titleEn: Treasury sanctions operation targets Iran's auto, rail industries in latest economic attack
news.conclusionEn: The US sanctioned Iran's biggest automakers, its state railway and foreign parts suppliers.
news.conclusionZh: 美国制裁伊朗主要车企、国家铁路及海外零部件供应商
news.whyEn: Sanctions now reach suppliers in Turkey, the UAE, Indonesia and Hong Kong, raising compliance risks for global firms.
news.whyZh: 制裁波及土耳其、阿联酋、印尼和香港供应商，全球企业合规风险上升
news.detailEn: Under "Operation Economic Outcast," Treasury designated Iran Khodro and SAIPA, which hold over 90% of Iran's car market, plus Islamic Republic of Iran Railways. Steel and manufacturing firms were also targeted. Washington says these sectors became key revenue sources after Iran's oil income collapsed during the war.
news.detailZh: 在「经济弃儿行动」下，美国财政部将占伊朗汽车市场九成以上份额的伊朗霍德罗和SAIPA以及伊朗国家铁路列入制裁名单，钢铁和制造业企业也被波及。美方称，伊朗石油收入在战争中大幅下滑后，这些行业已成为其重要收入来源。

news.titleEn: Election debate cancelled in Brazil, bomb scare outside Supreme Court
news.conclusionEn: Brazil's final TV debate was scrapped after Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro skipped it, ahead of Sunday's vote.
news.conclusionZh: 卢拉与弗拉维奥缺席，巴西大选最后一场辩论被取消
news.whyEn: Latin America's largest economy votes Sunday; the result will shape fiscal policy and the real.
news.whyZh: 拉美最大经济体周日投票，结果将影响财政政策和雷亚尔汇率
news.detailEn: TV Globo cancelled the debate after both frontrunners pulled out and last-minute court rulings changed debate rules. Lula has led every major poll for the first round and is widely expected to face Flavio Bolsonaro, son of the former president, in a runoff. Investors are watching for signals on spending discipline from both camps.
news.detailZh: 两位领先候选人退出、法院临时裁定改变辩论规则后，环球电视台取消了辩论。卢拉在所有主要首轮民调中领先，普遍预计将与前总统之子弗拉维奥·博索纳罗进入第二轮。投资者关注双方在财政纪律上的表态。

news.titleEn: Traffic chaos in Kyiv as Russian drone strikes close key bridge
news.conclusionEn: Repeated Russian drone strikes closed Kyiv's Southern Bridge and hit energy infrastructure around the capital.
news.conclusionZh: 俄军无人机反复打击，基辅南桥关闭、能源设施受损
news.whyEn: Kyiv says Russia has begun a campaign to cripple Ukraine's power grid before winter.
news.whyZh: 基辅称俄罗斯正发动冬季前摧毁乌克兰电网的攻势
news.detailEn: The Southern Bridge was struck four times in 24 hours, and the Paton Bridge was also shut, gridlocking the city. An overnight attack killed one person and damaged a 25-story residential building. Russia launched over 100 drones, nearly half jet-powered, and said it hit a substation in the Kyiv region and a port complex in Izmail.
news.detailZh: 南桥在24小时内被击中四次，帕顿桥也被关闭，城市交通瘫痪。夜间袭击造成1人死亡，一栋25层住宅楼受损。俄方发射逾100架无人机，近半为喷气式，并称击中基辅州一座变电站和伊兹梅尔港口设施。

businessTips.explanationEn: OKRs pair an ambitious, qualitative objective with 3-5 measurable key results that define success. They align teams around a few priorities and make progress visible. Good key results measure outcomes (e.g., retention) rather than activities (e.g., meetings held). Hitting about 70% of a stretch OKR is often considered a success.
businessTips.explanationZh: OKR把一个有挑战性的定性目标，与3-5个可衡量的关键结果配对。它让团队聚焦少数优先事项，并使进展可见。好的关键结果衡量的是成果（如留存率），而不是活动（如开了几次会）。对挑战性OKR来说，完成约70%通常就算成功。
businessTips.exampleEn: Objective: "Make onboarding delightful." Key results: raise day-7 retention from 40% to 55%, cut setup time from 20 to 8 minutes, and lift onboarding NPS above 50.
businessTips.exampleZh: 目标：「让新用户上手体验令人愉悦」。关键结果：7日留存从40%提升到55%，设置时间从20分钟缩短到8分钟，新手引导NPS超过50。

businessTips.explanationEn: Break-even analysis finds the sales volume at which revenue exactly covers costs: fixed costs divided by (price minus variable cost per unit). It tells you how much you must sell before making any profit. It is a fast sanity check before quitting a job or investing in inventory. Lowering fixed costs or raising contribution margin both bring break-even closer.
businessTips.explanationZh: 盈亏平衡分析计算收入刚好覆盖成本的销量：固定成本 ÷（单价 − 单位变动成本）。它告诉你要卖多少才开始赚钱，是辞职创业或囤货前的快速检验。降低固定成本或提高单位边际贡献，都能让盈亏平衡点更早到来。
businessTips.exampleEn: A candle side business has $600/month in fixed costs (studio rent, software) and sells candles for $30 that cost $10 to make. Break-even is 600 / 20 = 30 candles a month; every candle after that adds $20 of profit.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一个手工蜡烛副业每月固定成本600美元（工作室租金、软件），每支售价30美元、成本10美元。盈亏平衡点是600 ÷ 20 = 每月30支，之后每多卖一支就多赚20美元。

businessTips.explanationEn: Fed funds futures prices imply the market's expected interest rate, which tools like CME FedWatch convert into probabilities for each Fed decision. They show what is already "priced in." Asset prices move mainly when data shifts these probabilities, not when an expected decision happens. They are expectations, not forecasts guaranteed to be right.
businessTips.explanationZh: 联邦基金期货价格隐含了市场预期的利率，CME FedWatch等工具把它换算成每次议息会议的概率，显示哪些预期已「计入价格」。资产价格主要在数据改变这些概率时波动，而非预期中的决议落地时。它反映的是预期，并不保证准确。
businessTips.exampleEn: This week the odds of an October Fed hike fell from about 36% to 17% after soft inflation and a weak jobs report, and stocks rallied. If the Fed then holds in October, markets may barely react, because the hold was already priced in.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周通胀温和、就业疲软后，美联储10月加息概率从约36%降到17%，股市随之上涨。如果美联储10月真的按兵不动，市场可能几乎没反应，因为这已被提前计入价格。
